author: ACA
what_it_is: Game fully completed with everything unlocked by T64.
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak with notes ARMY MEN SARGE, A BUG'S LIFE and two GameShark cart-save notes (game code 3BADD1E5, publisher FADE): "SMSM" and "BKBK", 2 pages each = a 4 Kbit EEPROM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert banjo-kazooie.1141.n64 OUT --note BKBK: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; cart-save note 'BKBK' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): raw EEPROM, 512 bytes

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

mupen64plus-next.detail: Banjo's bed: GAME 1: TIME 43:21:24, 100 JIGSAWS, 900 NOTES

parallel-n64.detail: Banjo's bed: GAME 1: TIME 43:21:24, 100 JIGSAWS, 900 NOTES

mupen64plus.detail: the script's presses start Game 1 here (it boots faster): the pause screen shows 900 notes, 100 jiggies, 198 eggs, 100 red feathers, 19 gold feathers; with no save the same presses reach Gruntilda's intro

note: The BKBK note is a GameShark Memory Card Manager copy of the cartridge's EEPROM; the SMSM note beside it is Super Mario 64's (not converted). The cartridge revision is not recorded; Banjo-Kazooie (USA) (Rev 1), the library's release, was used. GameFAQs files this under DexDrive; it is one, with GameShark cart saves on the pak.
